method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stocks slip as Apple price hikes fan tech jitters, oil slides
Equities.reason: Broad market headline linking Apple price hikes to renewed tech jitters; signals risk aversion in large-cap tech leadership that pressures overall equity sentiment.

Equities.title: Stocks Rattled by Tech Selloff Again, Oil Retreats: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Market wrap emphasizing recurring tech-led volatility; reinforces negative near-term risk narrative for equities driven by AI/tech leadership swings.

Equities.title: Tumbling AI stocks signal another day of turmoil for tech companies
Equities.summary: SoftBank Group plunged, leading a broad selloff in Asian technology stocks amid mounting concerns over the rising cost of artificial intelligence infrastructure.
Equities.reason: Specific: AI infrastructure cost concerns and a large SoftBank selloff driving broad Asian tech weakness — a meaningful, sector-wide negative that amplifies global risk-off.

Equities.title: Equities: Tech selloff spreads despite chip strength – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists note that tech weakness extended from the Magnificent 7 and Apple into Asian markets, weighing on risk sentiment and US equity futures.
Equities.reason: Strategist note that tech weakness is broadening beyond megacaps into Asia and futures — supports a negative, cross-regional risk-sentiment view for equities.

Equities.title: Tech weakness sends weekly global equity fund inflows sharply lower
Equities.reason: Flow data showing a tangible shift out of equities tied to tech weakness — increases the market-impact relevance of the tech selloff narrative.

Equities.title: US Stocks Post First Outflow Since March as Tech Trade Falters
Equities.reason: Significant: US equity outflows (first since March) driven by faltering tech trade — strong evidence of a materially negative shift in investor positioning.

Equities.title: Emerging Market Stocks Slide Most in Three Weeks on Tech Selloff
Equities.reason: EM equities showing outsized weakness tied to global tech selloff — indicates cross-border transmission and broader market impact beyond US megacaps.

Equities.title: Korean Stocks Slump 6% as Chipmakers Hit by Renewed Selloff
Equities.reason: Regional market-level move (Korea -6%) tied to chipmaker weakness — a concentrated but large market impact that reinforces negative tech/regime risk for equities.

Equities.title: US Stock Futures Resume Declines as AI Concerns Stall Tech Rally
Equities.reason: Futures weakness reflects immediate market reaction to renewed AI concerns — an indicator of ongoing negative sentiment into US trading.

Equities.title: The tech selloff has a new worry, and it involves OpenAI’s IPO timeline
Equities.reason: Narrative piece linking IPO/timing uncertainty at a major AI company to investor sentiment — a plausible additional headwind but more speculative, hence lower relevance.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Strength extends as growth holds – Commerzbank
Rates.summary: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur notes that despite easing Oil prices and lower inflation expectations, market pricing still anticipates at least one more Federal Reserve rate hike by year-end, while the ECB is seen delivering only one further move to 2.5%.
Rates.reason: Market pricing of an additional Fed hike is a direct negative for bond prices (yields higher). This bank strategist note reinforces the higher-for-longer US rates narrative and USD-driven rate pressures.

Rates.title: Kevin Warsh’s tough talk on inflation reassures investors
Rates.summary: New Fed chair’s hawkish words and the fall in oil drive down long-term expectations for price rises
Rates.reason: Hawkish comments from the new Fed chair are a major driver for upward pressure on yields (bond selloff / higher-for-longer expectations). High relevance given the official role and market sensitivity.

Rates.title: Core inflation rate hit 3.4% in May, highest since October 2023, Fed’s preferred gauge shows
Rates.summary: The personal consumption expenditures price index was expected to show a 4.1% annual increase.
Rates.reason: A hotter-than-desired core PCE directly raises the probability of further Fed tightening or delayed cuts, which is negative for bond prices and supports higher yields.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve Board and Federal Open Market Committee release economic projections from the June 16-17 FOMC meeting
Rates.summary: Federal Reserve Board and Federal Open Market Committee release economic projections from the June 16-17 FOMC meeting
Rates.reason: Official FOMC projections are a high-signal input to rate expectations; given the current hawkish commentary and inflation prints, the projections reinforce a tighter/longer policy path (negative for bond prices).

Rates.title: Chicago Fed President Goolsbee says inflation is too high; Williams sees price pressures easing
Rates.summary: In a live CNBC interview from his home district, Goolsbee declined to speculate on where he thinks interest rates are headed.
Rates.reason: Regional/Fed-speak that inflation remains too high nudges markets toward higher-for-longer pricing, but mixed internal Fed views limit the standalone impact on yields.

Rates.title: Bond ETF flows surge in hunt for yield: 'Market sniffing out something here,' says BlackRock exec
Rates.summary: Bond investors are abandoning aggregate benchmarks in favor of a broad mix of fixed-income investments to maximize yield with the stock market on edge.
Rates.reason: Large inflows into bond ETFs indicate demand for fixed income which can support bond prices (lower yields). This is a flows-driven counterbalance to hawkish policy rhetoric, but the piece is market-structure/flow-focused so relevance is moderate.

Rates.title: Traders Pare ECB Rate Bets to Below Quarter-Point Hike in 2026
Rates.reason: Markets dialing back ECB hike expectations implies lower European yields / bond rally there — a positive for Eurozone rates and a material regional shift in rate expectations.

Rates.title: Asset Purchase Facility: Gilt Sales – Market Notice 19 June 2026
Rates.summary: This Market Notice sets out the schedule for sales in Q3 2026 of gilts held in the Asset Purchase Facility (APF) for monetary policy purposes.
Rates.reason: Planned sales of APF-held gilts increase supply to the market and are directly negative for gilt prices (puts upward pressure on UK yields). This is a concrete central-bank operational move with clear rates transmission.

Rates.title: Fed Chair Warsh taps veteran economists as advisers, WSJ reports
Rates.reason: Hiring experienced, likely hawkish advisers reinforces the Fed chair's credibility on inflation-fighting and supports a narrative of persistent policy hawkishness — modest negative for bond prices.

FX.title: US Dollar Index weakens below 101.50 after US PCE inflation as Fed rate hike odds fade
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 101.40 during the early European trading hours on Friday.
FX.reason: Direct DXY move after US PCE inflation; immediate USD weakness/repricing of Fed hike odds — high FX relevance and market-wide impact.

FX.title: US Dollar: Eases as markets reassess Fed – DBS
FX.summary: DBS Group Research strategist Philip Wee notes that the US Dollar Index (DXY) has seen its first post-FOMC decline as US inflation data suggest a possible peak.
FX.reason: Bank research note reinforcing the USD-easing narrative after inflation/Fed reassessment — reinforces DXY move, medium relevance.

FX.title: US Dollar: Structural support holds with high-for-longer rates – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan notes that strong United States (US macro data continue to support a high-for-longer US rates environment, with Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index inflation and Gross Domestic Product (GDP) both firm.
FX.reason: Countervailing macro narrative: robust US data and higher-for-longer rates provide structural USD support — important risk to a sustained USD decline.

FX.title: 162.00: Why the Japanese Yen is still trading near intervention levels despite inflation closing in on the BoJ target
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) is finding a firmer fundamental floor as inflation in the Greater Tokyo Area edges closer to the Bank of Japan’s (BoJ) 2% target. While the Yen has shown recent stability against the US Dollar, it remains locked in a high-stakes tug-of-w
FX.reason: FX-native central-bank/intervention narrative — intervention risk can cap USD/JPY and has cross-market FX implications; high relevance to JPY and USD flows.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Bearish bias intact against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann keep a constructive view on USD/JPY, noting the pair has held above strong support at 161.10 while trading quietly around 161.78.
FX.reason: Bank strategist expects continued JPY weakness vs USD — relevant as a regional FX view but lower relevance versus macro/central-bank headlines.

FX.title: Eurozone consumer one-year inflation expectations cool down to 3.5% - ECB survey shows
FX.summary: According to the latest European Central Bank (ECB) survey, one-year forward Eurozone inflation expectations are expected to cool down, but longer-term projections remain steady, Reuters reports.
FX.reason: ECB-survey driven easing of near-term inflation expectations reduces near-term ECB tightening odds — modest negative for EUR vs USD (lower ECB-hike premium).

FX.title: Yen wobbles near 40-year low as dollar pauses for breath
FX.reason: Major wire report highlighting extreme JPY weakness and enduring dollar strength — high-market-signal for JPY flows and risk to non-USD FX.

FX.title: British Pound struggles to lure buyers amid UK politics as intervention fears support JPY
FX.summary: The GBP/JPY cross struggles to capitalize on the previous day's modest recovery gains and seesaws between tepid gains/minor losses through the early European session on Friday. Spot prices currently trade just below mid-213.00s, nearly unchanged for the day am
FX.reason: Intervention fears supporting JPY are a material FX regime risk; while the piece is a cross, the intervention theme has broader FX transmission implications.

FX.title: Australian Dollar: Still in weak phase against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note AUD/USD remains under pressure after an impulsive decline, though oversold conditions have prompted near-term consolidation between 0.6880 and 0.6920.
FX.reason: Regional bank view highlighting AUD underperformance vs USD — supports USD-strength pockets (commodity/antipodean flow), moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold: Steadies after sharp correction – ING
Commodities.summary: ING strategists Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey observe that Gold stabilized after dropping below the $4,000/oz mark earlier in the week, supported by lower US Treasury yields following softer US inflation data.
Commodities.reason: Article links gold stabilization to lower US Treasury yields and softer US inflation — a classic bullish catalyst for precious metals. Medium relevance as it’s analyst commentary on near-term dynamics.

Commodities.title: Gold Steadies Near $4,000 as Inflation Data Eases Rate-Hike Bets
Commodities.reason: Bloomberg headline explicitly ties easing rate-hike bets (lower real rates) to gold support — high-impact market narrative for precious metals.

Commodities.title: Gold flat lines below $4,050 as Fed hike bets counter softer USD
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to build on its intraday bounce of around $50 from the $3,983-$3982 region and flat lines below the $4,050 level during the first half of the European session on Friday.
Commodities.reason: Highlights how renewed Fed hike expectations and USD safe-haven support are capping gold — clear near-term bearish pressure for the metal.

Commodities.title: Gold heads for fourth weekly drop as traders reassess Fed rate outlook
Commodities.reason: Reuters signals sustained downside (fourth weekly loss) driven by hawkish Fed bets and stronger dollar — high-relevance piece reinforcing bearish trend.

Commodities.title: Gold: Debasement trade over as prices slide – Societe Generale
Commodities.summary: Societe Generale’s team highlights a sharp reversal in Gold, with prices down 20% year-to-date and over 11% this month, undermining the Dollar debasement narrative.
Commodities.reason: Institutional note framing a material reversal in the 'debasement' bullish narrative — significant for market positioning and sentiment around gold.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD edges up, nearing $58 as the US Dollar takes a breather
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) has bounced up from seven-month lows below $56.00 on Friday, to reach session highs at $57.80 at the moment of writing.
Commodities.reason: Technical/short-term bounce as USD eases — positive but limited relevance given tactical nature of the move.

Commodities.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
Commodities.summary: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Friday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $58.19 per troy ounce, up 0.56% from the $57.87 it cost on Thursday.
Commodities.reason: Small intraday uptick in silver — low relevance, short-term price update.

Commodities.title: WTI Oil struggles below $70 amid expectations of higher Middle East supply
Commodities.summary: Crude Oil prices edge lower on Friday, with the US benchmark West Texas Intermediate (WTI) barrel changing hands at $69.65 at the time of writing. This is the lowest price since February 27, one day before the US and Israel launched a joint attack on Iran.
Commodities.reason: Article ties sub-$70 WTI to expectations of higher Middle East supply and resumed flows — bearish for oil prices and market tone.

Commodities.title: Oil: Downside momentum persists as flows recover – ING
Commodities.summary: ING strategists Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Oil rebounded after a vessel was struck in the Persian Gulf, but they stress that price momentum remains to the downside as flows through the Strait of Hormuz recover.
Commodities.reason: ING highlights persistent downside momentum as strategic flows recover — a market-structure view that reinforces bearish oil bias.

Commodities.title: Oil edges lower amid resumption of strait shipments even as vessel hit near Oman
Commodities.reason: Reuters note that resumption of shipments through the strait is weighing on prices despite incident — a tangible bearish flow catalyst.

Commodities.reason: EIA inventory drawdown and high refinery utilization are bullish fundamentals for crude — medium-high relevance for oil price support.

Commodities.summary: On April 28, 2026, the United Arab Emirates (UAE) announced that it was leaving OPEC, effective on May 1. OPEC was formed in 1960 by Iraq, Iran, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, and Venezuela, with the stated objective to "coordinate and unify petroleum policies among Me

Commodities.title: Key Kazakh Field Cuts Oil Output After Drones Hit Russian Plant
Commodities.reason: Supply disruption from a significant field cut is a direct bullish shock to crude fundamentals — relevant but geographically limited.

Commodities.title: China’s Collapsing Crude Oil Imports to Fall Further in June
Commodities.reason: Bloomberg frames a decline in China crude imports — a major demand-side negative for oil markets with elevated relevance.

Commodities.title: Permian natural gas production increased faster than crude oil
Commodities.summary: The Permian region's marketed natural gas production grew from 17.2 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in 2021 to 27.6 Bcf/d in 2025, a 60% increase, according to data from our latest Short Term Energy Outlook. Over the same period, crude oil production grew b
Commodities.reason: Large increase in Permian gas production is a clear supply-side bearish signal for US natural gas prices and regional market balance.

Commodities.title: Soybeans Fade Lower into the Midweek Close
Commodities.reason: Headline indicates softening in soybean prices — modest bearish signal for agricultural complex.

Commodities.title: Corn Slip Lower Late on Wednesday
Commodities.reason: Corn softening headline represents a small negative for grain prices and demand sentiment.

Crypto.title: Federal Reserve Board requests comment on proposal to require certain payment stablecoin issuers to maintain an effective customer identification program
Crypto.summary: Federal Reserve Board requests comment on proposal to require certain payment stablecoin issuers to maintain an effective customer identification program
Crypto.reason: High-quality regulatory clarity around stablecoins (KYC/CIP) is constructive for institutional adoption and payments rails — a net positive for crypto liquidity and legitimacy. It's a major policy signal so relevance is elevated.

Crypto.title: Asset management giant Invesco files for tokenized fund targeting stablecoin reserve market
Crypto.reason: Institutional product (tokenized fund focused on stablecoin reserves) signals growing institutional engagement and demand for crypto-native cash-management products — positive adoption impulse for the sector.

Crypto.title: Coinbase's Base blockchain resumes after two-hour outage disrupted network
Crypto.reason: Layer-2 infrastructure outage undermines reliability and user confidence; operational outages are a negative for ecosystem trust and can impair short-term flows. Impact is material but mostly technical, so relevance is moderate.

Crypto.title: Kraken in talks to buy 15% stake in DeFi lender Aave at $385 million valuation
Crypto.reason: Exchange acquisition stake in a major DeFi protocol signals consolidation and institutionalization of DeFi — modestly positive for on-chain credit markets and confidence in DeFi integrations.

Crypto.title: Kraken sues crypto derivatives firm PowerTrade over 'misappropriated' funds claim
Crypto.reason: Inter-exchange legal disputes and fund misappropriation allegations increase counterparty risk and reputational concerns in derivatives/clearing — negative but more idiosyncratic than systemic.

Crypto.title: CoinEx denies claims it served as $3.84 billion gateway to sanctioned Iranian crypto firms
Crypto.reason: Sanctions/gateway allegations raise regulatory and AML scrutiny risks for exchanges and the wider sector; the denial mitigates but does not eliminate reputational/regulatory downside.

Crypto.title: Ether, XRP and dogecoin lead a broad crypto selloff as tech stocks tumble
Crypto.reason: Cross-asset risk-off (tech equity weakness) is driving a broad crypto selloff; this is a high-relevance macro flow linking equities and crypto liquidity, and it is materially negative for risk assets.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin derivatives signal panic. A weak core PCE reading could trigger snapback.
Crypto.reason: Derivatives positioning shows elevated panic/liquidity stress — a negative for near-term price action. The note that macro (core PCE) could flip sentiment means this is important but not definitively directional.
